reviews.author: Edwin felin
reviews.text: This place is really unprofessional. I called yesterday night 3/20/2025 I spoke to someone explained to them I needed help with a flat tire. The guy said we can have someone out if they can’t help you it’s 22 dollars coverage fee and if they can 55. I told the guy sounds good I sent him where my car was located he said a driver will be out within 90min-2hrs. This was at 9:00pm. At 11:30pm I started emailing and calling no response from anyone. This was such a waste of my time. NEVER CALL THEM

reviews.author: Quinn Caruthers
reviews.text: GREAT GUY! Woke up out of his sleep at 3:30 in the morning, came to Philadelphia and got me home. I appreciate his help so much. I don't know what I would have done without it. Thank you so very much!

reviews.author: Tenisha Wheeler
reviews.text: My son was stuck on 295 between exits 56 and 57 with a blown out tire and no wheel locks. I contacted Car Finder $35 to be towed from A to B; however, an experienced Brian stated he can get the wheel locks off and change the tire with no need for a tow. Lo and behold, he did just that and got us on our way. He was very professional and knowledgeable, and I would definitely use and highly recommend his services. Great job Brian!

reviews.author: Kristy Roberts
reviews.text: Brian was very nice came out right away to change my flat tire which I didn't know had 2 stripped bolts. He worked really hard in the rain and got them off. He was such a blessing cause I didn't know what I was going to do if he didn't keep trying. I'm so thankful this is now my new roadside service company from now on.

reviews.author: Helen Goodwin
reviews.text: Brian was very helpful when I called about towing services! He helped me with my insurance roadside assistance program even though he knew I wouldn’t hire him to tow my car! Nice to meet honest service providers!

reviews.author: DEF Hemp
reviews.text: Today a good man towed my car. I called him and it took less than an hour to come get my car. In less than 5 minutes we were on our way. He was polite and intelligent but firm. The rate was a fair rate. If you are ever on the side of the road in trouble, in an accident, or just need a tow this is the man to call. I am a real person who randomly called this guy and he is going to be the only tow service I ever call.

reviews.author: Linda Livingston
reviews.text: Very professional towing service, and the prices are reasonable. I was very impressed by the fast response, and the driver was very knowledgeable and helped me figure out the problem with my car. Thanks again, two thumbs up for Car Finder towing in Camden!

reviews.author: MJoseph Gen
reviews.text: Brian was excellent. He was professional and knew how to solve the problem we had with our vehicle. Very reasonable price, too. Thanks.

reviews.author: Grace Rodriguez
reviews.text: Great guy!!! He was patient.. very humble.. nice man.. I will be calling for services again if I need it and refer to other ppl.. happy new year!!!

reviews.author: LaToya Salva
reviews.text: Great service! Brian was super professional and worked a miracle to retrieve my car. I would definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Jetermom2 Jeter
reviews.text: EXCELLENT tow truck services, timely, REASONABLY PRICED. I HIGHLY recommend Car Finder Towing. So satisfied, I immediately shared their information with my social networking friends. #happycustomer!

reviews.author: Tiffany Leggette
reviews.text: 24/7 roadside assistance? Yeah, right! They don't even answer the phone! The phone rings 10-12 times before it's answered by an automated voice. Every option says they're not available, so leave a message. If I'm in need of service RIGHT NOW, how is leaving a message supposed to help me?

reviews.author: Samantha Lanholm
reviews.text: Great service. My car was very far and instead of charging over charging me, he helped me find a more reasonably priced tow

reviews.author: Bianca Soler
reviews.text: The person who I called was very helpful by finding me a way to save money by offering suggestions on what I should do with my car. He was very nice.

reviews.author: Afua Nimako
reviews.text: The best towing company ever. Very professional service. I call them at night and they came on time to help me thanks a lot

reviews.author: Arthur Swanson
reviews.text: This guy was honest enough to refer me to a pep boys shop that would be cheaper for me. You know you're not going to get cheated when dealing with a company like that.
